verdict.rationale: Mollie provides webhooks for real-time payment status updates, a Webhook Events API for retrospective inspection, and an MCP server exposing Payments/Webhooks/Subscriptions APIs that an agent could poll or subscribe to, giving the building blocks for monitoring failed payments. However, there is no documented dunning/retry automation, no failed-payment-specific workflow, and no evidence of built-in retry scheduling or outreach templating that an agent could just invoke. missing for 10: dedicated failed-payment/dunning API or workflow, documented retry logic for failed payments, evidence of agent-driven outreach (email/notification) tied to payment failure, and any independent/hands-on confirmation this monitoring+retry loop works end-to-end.
